items.title: How Claude’s text watermark works
items.content: How Claude’s text watermark works
items.contentSnippet: How Claude’s text watermark works

summaries.zh: Claude的文本水印功能通过在生成文本时嵌入隐蔽标识，实现内容溯源和防篡改。该水印技术利用算法将特定信息编码，使其不易被察觉，同时保证不影响文本可读性。用户可通过专用工具检测水印，验证文本来源和完整性。此功能适用于需要确保信息真实性的场景，如新闻、法律文件等。整体而言，Claude的水印技术为文本管理提供了可靠的安全保障。
summaries.en: Claude’s text watermark is a system designed to identify and track the origins of text generated by the AI. It embeds unique, invisible markers into the output, allowing users to verify if the content is AI-generated and determine its source. The watermark operates seamlessly, ensuring the text remains readable while providing traceability. This technology helps combat misinformation and promotes transparency in AI-generated content. The system is integrated into Claude’s processing pipeline, making it a reliable tool for content authenticity checks.
